# aether_kubeconfig (Data Source)

The cluster's administrator kubeconfig, the same file the portal downloads. It grants cluster-admin: treat the Terraform state as a secret. It is available only while the cluster is `running`; a plan that reads it fails while the cluster is upgrading or degraded.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "cluster_id" {
  type = string
}

# Admin kubeconfig (sensitive, stored in state); readable only while the cluster is running.
data "aether_kubeconfig" "this" {
  cluster_id = var.cluster_id
}

output "kubeconfig" {
  value     = data.aether_kubeconfig.this.content
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) UUID of the cluster.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String, Sensitive) The kubeconfig YAML, byte for byte as the API serves it.
